limitations: Six hero 2x exports are upscaled from ~1944px source to 2400px, not native high-resolution images.
The alternate oatmeal PNG is 1024px; its 1200px export is upscaled.
Commercial use terms, exact generation prompts and generation model were not supplied in the source manifest.
Pixel-level edge halo and real-browser contrast tests remain necessary before visual acceptance.
integration_rules: One selected image per slot; existing SVG remains fallback.
Decorative media alt empty; informative food examples receive truthful alt and never stand in for logged items.
Biology conceptual image requires adjacent visible label Illustrative, not your data.
Do not change DOM/focus order, controls, data or source disclosures.
Use srcset and reserve sizes; load only actual above-fold LCP eagerly.
Do not halt unrelated R4 implementation for media asset QA.
